name: ride-cyclist-rosedale
js: (()=>{const app=window.__CITY_APP,C=window.CITY;app.cameraSystem.cinema=null;app.selectMode('cyclist');const cut=C.ROAD_CUTS.find(c=>c.name==='Rosedale Valley Road');app.teleportTo(1479.2+-0.784,-2755.8+1.84,1.17);const e=app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity();const aim=(x,z)=>{let best=null;for(const g of cut.segs){const dx=x-g.a.x,dz=z-g.a.z;const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(g.len,dx*g.ux+dz*g.uz));const d=Math.hypot(dx-g.ux*t,dz-g.uz*t);if(!best||d<best.d)best={d,g,t};}const g=best.g;const ahead=Math.min(g.len,best.t+12);const px=g.a.x+g.ux*ahead-g.uz*2.0,pz=g.a.z+g.uz*ahead+g.ux*2.0;return Math.atan2(px-x,pz-z);};const t0=performance.now();let last=-1,maxDy=0,py=null,lo=1e9,hi=-1e9,minV=1e9,vmax=0,cutMin=0;const id=setInterval(()=>{const t=(performance.now()-t0)/1000;const p=e.position;const fx=Math.sin(e.heading),fz=Math.cos(e.heading);const blocked=[...app.trafficSystem.cars,...app.trafficSystem.buses].some(v=>{const dx=v.x-e.position.x,dz=v.z-e.position.z,ah=dx*fx+dz*fz,side=Math.abs(-dx*fz+dz*fx);return v.active!==false&&ah>0&&ah<9&&side<2.2&&Math.abs((v.y||0)-e.position.y)<2.5;});app.controllerManager.keys.forward=t<44&&!blocked?1:0;app.controllerManager.keys.backward=blocked&&(e.speed||0)>0.5?1:0;if(t>2&&C.cutAt(p.x,p.z)<0)e.heading=aim(p.x,p.z);const ground=C.cutAt(p.x,p.z)+(C.blockAt(p.x,p.z)?C.CITY_BOUNDS.sidewalkHeight:0);const off=p.y-ground;if(py!==null)maxDy=Math.max(maxDy,Math.abs(p.y-py));py=p.y;const v=e.speed||0;if(t>4&&p.x>1500&&p.x<1745&&p.x>1500){lo=Math.min(lo,off);hi=Math.max(hi,off);minV=Math.min(minV,v);cutMin=Math.min(cutMin,C.cutAt(p.x,p.z));}vmax=Math.max(vmax,v);if(Math.floor(t*2)!==last){last=Math.floor(t*2);console.log('[ride] ride-cyclist-rosedale t '+t.toFixed(1)+' x '+p.x.toFixed(1)+' z '+p.z.toFixed(1)+' y '+p.y.toFixed(2)+' cut '+C.cutAt(p.x,p.z).toFixed(2)+' off '+off.toFixed(2)+' v '+v.toFixed(1)+' maxStep '+maxDy.toFixed(3)+' near '+[...app.trafficSystem.cars,...app.trafficSystem.buses].filter(v=>v.active!==false&&Math.hypot(v.x-p.x,v.z-p.z)<15).map(v=>(Math.hypot(v.x-p.x,v.z-p.z)).toFixed(0)+'m/v'+(v.speed||0).toFixed(1)+'/y'+(v.y||0).toFixed(1)).join(','));}if(t>45){clearInterval(id);console.log('[ride] ride-cyclist-rosedale SUMMARY in-cut off '+lo.toFixed(2)+'..'+hi.toFixed(2)+' minV '+minV.toFixed(1)+' vmax '+vmax.toFixed(1)+' maxStep '+maxDy.toFixed(3)+' deepest '+cutMin.toFixed(2)+' end x '+p.x.toFixed(1));}},50);})()
